cam_maths.text: I'm doing maths. Same course Newton did, just with fewer plague years. In 1665 the university shut for the plague and he went home to Lincolnshire and invented half of calculus.

Alan Turing was at King's. Charles Darwin was at Christ's, where he mostly collected beetles. Once he had a beetle in each hand, saw a third, and popped one in his mouth to free a hand. It squirted him. He lost all three.
